الدنيا سجن المؤمن: Relative worldly restrictions and afterlife comparison, not all believers being materially poor.
وجنة الكافر: Worldly pleasure relative to afterlife punishment on continued disbelief, not every nonbeliever materially happy.
المكروهة: Things discouraged/whose avoidance recommended, distinguished from prohibited.
هوان الدنيا: Low worldly worth, not meaningless creation.
